library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#read the rds
data <- readRDS("/pat_to_folder/All_merged_after_integration_annotated_20260225.rds")



#plot the Dimsplot
#plot with no legend
p <- DimPlot(
  data,
  reduction = "umap",
  label = FALSE,   # turn off default labels
  pt.size = 1.5
) + NoLegend()

p


p <- LabelClusters(
  plot = p,
  id = "ident",
  repel = TRUE,
  size = 5,
  fontface = "bold"
)
p

#Plot with legend
p1 <- DimPlot(
  data,
  reduction = "umap",
  label = FALSE,   # turn off default labels
  pt.size = 1.5
)

p1
